# Huntsman Savile Row

> > Huntsman Savile Row: Legendary bespoke tailoring house at 11 Savile Row offering hand-crafted suits, ready-to-wear menswear, women's tailoring, and luxury accessories since 1849.

Huntsman is one of the most prestigious tailoring houses on Savile Row, renowned for its signature single-breasted house cut, full hand-made canvas construction, and collaborations with luxury brands like Bentley Mulliner. The house offers bespoke services for men and women, ready-to-wear collections, and lifestyle accessories including knitwear by John Smedley and eyewear with E.B. Meyrowitz.

## Key Topics

- Savile Row bespoke tailoring
- Huntsman house cut
- Single-breasted jackets and blazers
- Ready-to-wear menswear
- Women's bespoke tailoring
- Merino wool and cashmere knitwear
- John Smedley collaboration
- Luxury overcoats and outerwear
- Hand-made canvas construction
- Bentley Mulliner partnership
- British wool and tweed
- Tailored fit shirts
- Neckwear and accessories
- 11 Savile Row flagship
- New York W57th Street location
